description: LIVE MODEL EVALUATION dataset — realistic natural-language goals for the REAL agent model to route. Distinct from the deterministic scripted regression (evaluations/agent/tool_selection_cases.json). Expectations describe required/forbidden tools, whether retrieval/HITL should occur, and a tool-call budget — never exact answer text.
